question: Rider plus bike weigh 78 kg. On a 30-minute climb, at the same power, how many seconds does a bike 1 kg lighter save?
answer: About 23 seconds over half an hour
move: Measure a saving against the whole load, not the part you changed.
ask: Is the upgrade I want a big share of one part, but a tiny share of the whole?
trap: Expecting a big gain because the bike lost an eighth of its weight.
hint: Work out what share of the total mass 1 kg is.
steps: On a steep climb, time at the same power scales with total mass
About 23 seconds over half an hour
source: di Prampero et al., J Appl Physiol, 1979
reference: di Prampero, Cortili, Mognoni & Saibene, Equation of motion of a cyclist, Journal of Applied Physiology, 1979
